variants.headline: Party leader faces a public scandal
variants.sub: The leader of {party}, {leader}, is the subject of a newly revealed scandal.
variants.body:
A scandal concerning {leader}, the leader of {party}, has come to light. The revelation makes political trust an immediate subject of public attention. An assessment of {target} must distinguish that known fact from unreported details about the conduct involved, its cause or any proceedings that might follow.

The gazette confines its factual account to the revelation of the scandal. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: Leadership under an unwelcome spotlight
variants.sub: A scandal about {leader}, leader of {party}, has become public.
variants.body:
The leader of {party}, {leader}, is the subject of a newly revealed scandal. A newly revealed scandal concerning a party leader gives that claim an uncomfortable setting in {colony}. Readers considering {target} should be able to examine responsibility without being invited to accept a more specific accusation than the report establishes.

The gazette confines its factual account to the revelation of the scandal. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: A scandal tests political trust
variants.sub: A scandal concerning {leader}, the leader of {party}, has come to light.
variants.body:
A scandal about {leader}, leader of {party}, has become public. That is serious political news; it is not permission to fill gaps with an attractive story. For {target}, the question of trust deserves attention without a fabricated account of money, private life or criminal conduct.

The gazette confines its factual account to the revelation of the scandal. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.
